title: quenched japanese allspice udon
description: buttery, crisp, and comforting japanese udon dish featuring ground allspice and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: cook the udon noodles in boiling salted water according to package instructions and set aside.
in a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium heat.
add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add 1 cup of ferment-kimchi and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through, then stir in 1 teaspoon of ground allspice.
